_comment: Declarative LLM-resolver arm list (operator ask #7, ratified 2026-07-19). render-llm-arms.sh renders ONE systemd unit + ONE single-provider env file per arm; each arm is enabled iff its provider key is present (ExecCondition, so a keyless host cleanly skips it — law 11 location independence). Each arm is one (model, provider) pinned instance: vessel_id == llm-resolver-<id>, its quota == its provider's quota, so it de-advertises through discovery when that provider cools and callers resolve to a live arm (LAW: resolve THROUGH discovery, quota-gated advertisement). Adding an arm = add one entry here; it registers through discovery and is selectable fleet-wide within the namespace, regardless of which host it runs on. Override the whole list at hub/deploy setup via the LLM_ARMS env var (a JSON array with the same shape as .arms) — nothing about the arm set is hardcoded in a unit file.
